python-pptx>=0.6.23
PyYAML>=6.0
Pillow>=10.0.0
cairosvg>=2.7
# Notes for the zip-agent build (see vendor/README.md):
# - jsonschema removed: declared upstream but imported nowhere (validation is hand-rolled in reader.py).
# - cairosvg is KEPT (it renders SVG assets) but is deliberately NOT in the offline `--pptx`
#   wheelhouse: it needs the system Cairo library (libcairo), which a pip wheel can't supply. Where
#   SVG assets are used, the agent installs it at runtime (`pip install cairosvg`; it has network) on
#   a host that has Cairo. Raster (png/jpg) assets need only Pillow, which IS in the wheelhouse.
